skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the history and structure of the hotel industry.
Identify job opportunities and requirements in the hospitality industry.
Develop personal career plans and strategies for advancement.
Analyze current trends and future prospects in the hospitality industry.
Understand and apply Vietnam Tourism Occupational Skills Standards (VTOS).
Apply critical thinking to analyze job requirements and career paths.
Demonstrate a professional attitude towards the hospitality industry.
Work collaboratively in group settings to solve problems and present findings.
